ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The horse keeps its things in locker 8. ... The goat keeps its things in locker 1. ... The snake keeps its things in locker 0. ... In which locker does the animal known for climbing cliffs keep its things?" -> answer org 1; the alt prompt asks about the snake (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: 0 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 8 (answer at the same statement slot), 9 (the alt prompt's own answer), 1 (answer org kept).
